'''Cargo Port A3''' was a building located in the [[Kaas City]] on [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]]. Following the destruction of the [[Dominator (Harrower-class)|''Dominator'']] by the [[Eagle's network]], [[Cipher Nine]] was send to the building the eliminate members of the local terrorist cell.
